## Tag `ucglef1-v1.0.0`
`golden.lock` records `ucglef1_freeze_commit: "ucglef1-v1.0.0"` (a tag name, no SHA). The freeze commit is the one that wrote `physics_dir_hash: 42805c73…92dd` into the lock: `git log -S'42805c73…' -- backend/audit/golden.lock` → `73ae381` ("chore(reconcile): execute PROMPT 0 v2 — freeze migration…"). Verified: `backend/audit/physics` exported at `73ae381` hashes to `42805c73538df5eb0f9eb109ead9a541253d5371d71eac5ea04be0ffaf8e92dd` (dirhash sha256, ignores `*.pyc`, `__pycache__`, `.pytest_cache`, `golden.lock`).
An annotated tag was created locally at `73ae38142ae936fa1aeecf1f842dc34d234369d4`. `git push origin refs/tags/ucglef1-v1.0.0` fails three times with "the remote end hung up unexpectedly", while branch pushes succeed. The session's git proxy refuses tag refs. The GitHub tools available here can't create tag refs either.
**James:** `git tag -a ucglef1-v1.0.0 73ae38142ae936fa1aeecf1f842dc34d234369d4 -m "UCGLE-F1 v1.0.0 freeze" && git push origin ucglef1-v1.0.0`.

## Supabase variables
- `.env` (Supabase URL, project id and publishable key, both plain and `VITE_`-prefixed) is removed from the tree (`git rm --cached`; the local copy stays so `bun run dev` keeps working). `.gitignore` now ignores `.env` and `.env.*` except `.env.example`.
- `.env.example` lists every variable the frontend, Worker and Python code reads, with names only.
- R9 degrade: `src/integrations/supabase/{client,client.server}.ts` no longer throw when variables are missing. They return `unconfiguredClient` (`src/integrations/supabase/unconfigured.ts`), which warns `BLOCKED-ON-JAMES:<VAR>` once and resolves every query or auth call as a supabase-js `{ data, error }` failure, with no default project. `auth-middleware.ts` answers 503 `BLOCKED-ON-JAMES:<VAR>` instead of 500. Unit tests: `src/integrations/supabase/__tests__/unconfigured.test.ts` (2 tests).

## Drift alarm (plan-author correction 10)
I applied the authorised two-line patch to `.github/workflows/ucglef1-drift-alarm.yml` (`66e4b9e`): `uv pip install "dirhash>=0.5"` and `uv run --no-sync dirhash …`. Nothing else in the file changed; the hash and compare logic is byte-for-byte the same.
The next unchanged step then failed with "Failed to spawn: pytest", because `uv sync --package ucgle_f1` didn't install test tools. Fixed outside the workflow with `ucgle_f1`'s own default dev dependency group (`324eb4e`; LEDGER "Correction 10 follow-up").

| Run | Branch / head | Result |
|---|---|---|
| https://github.com/jamesrhule/cosmic-forge/actions/runs/41216310823 | `build/w0-consolidate` @ `324eb4e` (PR #3) | **success**: audits pass; physics dirhash `42805c73…92dd` = `golden.lock` |
| https://github.com/jamesrhule/cosmic-forge/actions/runs/41216312782 | `build/w0-drift-proof` @ `99c326f` (draft PR #4) | **failure**: 7 failed, 73 passed |

The deliberate drift is one byte under `backend/src/ucgle_f1/`: in `m8_agent/bibliography.json`, arXiv id `1702.07689` → `1702.07680`. The alarm fails on `test_references_resolvable[S1,S2,S8,S14,S15]`, `test_cite_paper_valid` and one more A-audit, all "cites unknown arXiv:1702.07689". PR #4 was closed without merging. The scratch branch's remote deletion is `BLOCKED-ON-JAMES:branch-delete-permission` (LEDGER).

**Coverage finding (recorded, not hidden).** Before choosing that byte I tried two physics bytes locally. Both passed all 81 fast audits, so the alarm would not have caught them:
- `M_PL_GEV` 2.4352e18 → 3.4352e18 (`m1_background/background.py:26`);
- inflaton dilution `dphi = -3.0 * rho_phi` → `-4.0 *` (`background.py:81`).
The alarm hashes `backend/audit/physics/` (the tests) and runs the fast audits. It doesn't hash `backend/src`, and today's S1–S15 assertions only check well-formedness and references, not physics outcomes. P1-08 restores the strict S1–S15 assertions and adds V2/V3/V5 recovery tests. P1-08's done-when check should include re-running these two drifts and seeing them fail.
